title: 村祭 (Mura Matsuri — Village Festival)
description: A cheerful Meiji-era school song celebrating a village harvest festival at the local shrine. Flutes and drums (笛太鼓) can be heard from morning, the village turns out in force for the great festival, and even hearing the music stirs the heart with courage. The repeated onomatopoeia 'ドンドンヒャララ ドンヒャララ' vividly evokes the sound of festival drums and flute.
